services.desc: See what’s on at the museum. Our current and upcoming exhibits explore Western history and local heritage through stories, artifacts, and hands on experiences. Aloha Vaqueros explores the cultural connections between Hawaiian traditions and the American West. This unique traveling exhibit highlights how ranching, music, and horseback heritage were shared across the Pacific. This special exhibit for America 250, Cheyenne Frontier Days™ and the American Story: Presidents Across Time, reflects on the nation’s journey and the stories that have shaped it over time.
